name: get_patent_overview_by_text_query
description: Search for patent application overviews using a query string of the format 'field:value', where value is the case-insensitive term you are searching for. Common fields: 'applicationMetaData.inventionTitle:your_search_term' to search by title, and 'applicationMetaData.patentNumber:9022434' to look up a granted patent by its patent number (use the plain number, e.g. 9022434 not US9022434B2; do not prefix with 'patentCaseMetadata' or 'patentGrantIdentification'). A 404 'no matching records' response means that specific patent is absent from the Patent File Wrapper dataset (coverage has gaps), not that the query is malformed. If your_search_term is a multi-word phrase, it must be encased in escaped double quotation marks for exact matching. This tool allows for sorting, offsetting, and filtering of results. Returns a list of important metadata fields for each application, including application number, filing date, grant date, invention title, and CPC classifications. Requires a valid USPTO_API_KEY; a 403 Forbidden response means the key was rejected (invalid/expired/not-yet-activated), not a query problem.

query.description: Keyword or keyphrase to search for in the patent application title. This field is required.

exact_match.description: If true, the search will only return results that exactly match the provided query. Default is false.

sort.description: Sorts results by one of the following fields: filingDate or grantDate. Follow the field name with a space and 'asc' or 'desc' for ascending or descending by date, respectively. For example: 'filingDate desc'

offset.description: The starting position (zero-indexed) of the result set. Default is 0.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default is 25.

rangeFilters.description: Limits results to the date range specified for one of the following fields: filingDate or grantDate. Provide the field name, a space, and a colon-separated start and end value in YYYY-MM-DD format. For example: 'grantDate 2010-01-01:2011-01-01'

USPTO_API_KEY.purpose: Search US patents and patent-application full text.
USPTO_API_KEY.without: USPTO patent tools are blocked without it.

name: USPTO_get_patent_assignment
description: Get the chain of title (ownership history) for a US patent application. Returns every assignment recorded with the USPTO: who transferred rights (assignor), who received them (assignee), when it was recorded, and the type of transfer (assignment, merger, security interest, etc.). Use this to determine who currently owns a patent and trace how ownership changed over time. Requires an application number — use USPTO_patent_number_to_application to convert patent numbers first.

applicationNumberText.description: The application number of the patent (e.g., '14966067'). This is NOT the patent number — use USPTO_patent_number_to_application to convert.

assignmentBag.description: Each entry is one recorded assignment (ownership transfer)

name: USPTO_get_patent_transactions
description: Get the full prosecution history timeline for a US patent application. Returns every event recorded by the USPTO: office actions (rejections, allowances), applicant responses, fee payments, publication events, and more. Each event has a code, description, and date. Use this to understand what happened during examination and when. Requires an application number — use USPTO_patent_number_to_application to convert patent numbers first.

applicationNumberText.description: The application number of the patent (e.g., '14966067'). This is NOT the patent number — use USPTO_patent_number_to_application to convert.

name: USPTO_get_enriched_citation_fields
description: List the searchable fields of the USPTO Enriched Citation dataset (enriched_cited_reference_metadata v3). Returns the field list, dataset status, and last data update date. Use this first to learn which fields are queryable before searching citations with USPTO_search_enriched_citations. The API is the USPTO Open Data Portal DSAPI; data covers office actions mailed from 2017-10-01 to 30 days before the current date.

name: USPTO_get_patent_application
description: Get the full patent application record for an application number. Returns bibliographic data for the application. Requires an application number (e.g., '14966067') -- use USPTO_patent_number_to_application to convert patent numbers first.

applicationNumberText.description: The application number of the patent (e.g., '14966067'). This is NOT the patent number -- use USPTO_patent_number_to_application to convert.

name: USPTO_get_patent_attorney
description: Get the attorney/agent of record for a US patent application. Returns the registered attorney or agent associated with the application. Requires an application number (e.g., '14966067') -- use USPTO_patent_number_to_application to convert patent numbers first.

applicationNumberText.description: The application number of the patent (e.g., '14966067'). This is NOT the patent number -- use USPTO_patent_number_to_application to convert.

name: USPTO_get_patent_documents
description: Get document details for a US patent application. Returns metadata for documents in the application file wrapper (e.g., office actions, responses, fee worksheets). Optionally filter by document codes and official date range. Requires an application number (e.g., '14966067') -- use USPTO_patent_number_to_application to convert patent numbers first.

applicationNumberText.description: The application number of the patent (e.g., '14966067'). This is NOT the patent number -- use USPTO_patent_number_to_application to convert.

documentCodes.description: Single or multiple comma-separated document codes (e.g., 'SRFW,SRNT' for search reports, 'WFEE' for fee worksheet).

officialDateFrom.description: Filter by document official date from, format yyyy-MM-dd.

officialDateTo.description: Filter by document official date to, format yyyy-MM-dd.

name: USPTO_get_patent_status_codes
description: Search USPTO patent application status codes and their descriptions. Returns the code-to-description mapping used in application status fields. Optionally filter with a query string.

q.description: Search query string (e.g., 'Abandoned' or a status code).

name: USPTO_search_patent_applications
description: Search USPTO patent applications with a JSON-body POST (Lucene query). Returns application records matching the query. Use for complex queries that exceed GET URL limits. Query with Lucene syntax, e.g. 'applicationNumberText:14412875' or 'applicationMetaData.applicationTypeLabelName:Utility AND applicationMetaData.applicationStatusCode:150'. Response: count + patentFileWrapperDataBag.

offset.description: Position in the dataset to start from (default 0).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 25).

name: USPTO_search_patent_status_codes
description: Search USPTO patent application status codes and descriptions with a JSON-body POST. Returns the code-to-description mapping (e.g. 165 = ABANDONED - RESTORED). Query with Lucene syntax, e.g. 'applicationStatusDescriptionText:Abandoned'.

offset.description: Position in the dataset to start from (default 0).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 25).

name: USPTO_search_bulk_datasets
description: Search the USPTO Bulk Data Storage System (BDSS) product catalog. Returns available bulk dataset products (e.g. patent grants, trademark assignments) with identifiers and descriptions. Query with q (e.g. 'patent') or browse unfiltered.

name: USPTO_get_bulk_dataset_product
description: Get a bulk data product from the USPTO BDSS catalog by its identifier (shortName). Returns product metadata including available files and date ranges.

productIdentifier.description: Product identifier (shortName), e.g. 'PTGRXML' for patent grants XML.

name: USPTO_download_bulk_dataset_file
description: Download a bulk data product file from the USPTO BDSS. Returns the file content (CSV/XML, may be large).

fileName.description: File name within the product, e.g. 'ipg200908.zip'.
